brief:
Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton attributed full responsibility for the Israeli-Palestinian conflict to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, the Quincy Institute reported. Clinton's statement represented an unusually sweeping assignment of blame to the Israeli leader for the decades-long dispute, though the specific circumstances and venue for her remarks were not detailed in the available summary.

The Quincy Institute, an independent foreign policy think tank, documented Clinton's position. Her comments contribute to an ongoing international debate over Israel's central role in the conflict and persistent disagreements between parties over the conditions and prospects for peace negotiations.

title: Clinton pins Israeli-Palestinian conflict solely on Netanyahu
